items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tell me, some people have told me that Millenburg was part colored... [INTERVIEWEE] Well I don't know anything about that.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, well I mean they had camps out on top of that's colored, but I don't know, but we, let's see, a fellow called Hickman, Albert Boyd Banks, Louis Gallo. Louis Gallo played the piano. I forgot we played the drum. Anyway, we played out there on the weekends, quite a while. I played a trumpet then.
Tell me, some people have told me that Millenburg was part colored, or one time it was white and then they changed it to colored, or was there any?
Well I don't know anything about that.
